reply: The LED NIR kidney study cannot be cited as proof for clinical readiness in tumor boundary decisions during live surgery. It was an in vitro study with limited scope and high measurement variance, indicating further development is needed. The next steps should include defining the specific variable to measure and conducting in vivo validation on your setup.
